name: Dr. Marcus Okafor, MD
reviews: Dr. Okafor did my colonoscopy and made the whole thing painless. Great bedside manner.
Very knowledgeable about IBS and reflux. Helped me get my digestion under control after years of discomfort.
Professional and efficient. The endoscopy suite is modern and the staff is kind.
He diagnosed my celiac disease when my primary care doctor thought it was just stress.
profile_text: Dr. Marcus Okafor is a board-certified gastroenterologist with a general GI practice spanning digestive and bowel disorders. He performs diagnostic and screening endoscopy and colonoscopy and treats conditions including irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), acid reflux and GERD, inflammatory bowel disease, and celiac disease. He has a particular interest in the diagnostic workup of chronic digestive complaints and offers celiac testing for patients with suspected gluten sensitivity or unexplained malabsorption.
guideline_text: Evaluation of chronic GI and malabsorption complaints: begin with a focused history of bowel habits, weight change, and dietary triggers. For suspected malabsorption, test for celiac disease (tTG-IgA with total IgA) and consider duodenal biopsy via upper endoscopy when serology is positive or suspicion is high. Screen for inflammatory bowel disease with fecal calprotectin and colonoscopy where indicated. Manage IBS with dietary modification (low-FODMAP) and symptom-directed therapy. Refer to hematology for management of anemia secondary to a confirmed GI source; gastroenterology identifies and treats the GI cause but does not manage iron repletion directly.
